title: Finite-time blowup of the Euler equation without forcing
summary:
These notes present the construction in \cite{euler} of finite-time blowup for the three-dimensional incompressible, unforced Euler equations on $\mathbb R^3$:  egin{equation} \partial_tu+(u\cdot
abla)u+
abla p=0,\qquad 
abla\cdot u=0. \end{equation} The construction successively adds oscillatory layers to smooth parent solutions. Each layer is constructed by a finite expansion and an exact correction, so that the resulting child solves Euler.
